# Terraform Cloudflare Module Template

> Baseline template for every Terraform module in the terraform-cf-modules organisation.

Terraform module for Cloudflare, maintained by CloudDrove. Source: ``. Repository: https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-module-template

Requires Terraform >= 1.12.0 (or OpenTofu >= 1.12) and the `cloudflare/cloudflare` provider ~> 5.24. Provider v5 renamed most resources from v4, so verify resource names against the current provider docs rather than older examples.

## Usage

```hcl
module "this" {
  source  = ""
  version = "~> 0.1"
}
```

## Submodules

Each is separately addressable with the double slash source syntax.

- [example](https://github.com/terraform-cf-modules/terraform-module-template/tree/main/modules/example): `//modules/example`
